metadata.description: Q11 frozen blind compatibility pair list. Contains no labels. Labels live in compatibility_2026_q11_labels_hidden.json and were assigned before any prediction was run.
metadata.selection_policy: 40 pairs across battery, polymer, metal, ceramic, semiconductor, and glass-metal sealing. Every pair was checked to have ZERO material-name-pair overlap with blind_test_pairs, ground_truth, all prior external_blind (Q2-Q10), and all dev_compatibility files. Materials are drawn from the EXISTING bridge vocabulary so that unresolved names cannot cause a Q8-style skip storm: this makes Q11 a test of generalization to unseen material COMBINATIONS, not to unseen materials.
metadata.holdout_policy: Q11 is current_blind. Run for reporting only. It must never be used for scorer tuning or calibration. If its errors are inspected for remediation, its role must be changed to spent_diagnostic and a new blind set frozen. Q10 remains sealed and is NOT consumed by this freeze.
known_limitations: Labels are expert-judgment from materials-science first principles, not curated external experimental ground truth.
Labels were authored by the same AI assistant that has worked on this codebase; this is a weaker independence guarantee than an external labeler and is disclosed deliberately.
Pairs reuse known materials in unused combinations; this does not test out-of-vocabulary materials.
Several pairs are role/context dependent (e.g. solvent exposure vs. processing); the intended role is stated per pair.
